author: Chanakya, Satya Vrat Shastri
title: Chanakya Niti With Hindi and English Translation by Satya Vrat Shastri - Bharatiya Vidya Mandir Kolkata
description: Chanakya Niti is a foundational text of Indian ethical and political thought, attributed to Chanakya—the strategist who helped establish the Mauryan Empire. It presents concise teachings on leadership, discipline, social conduct, and statecraft. Unlike the more technical Arthashastra, Chanakya Niti focuses on everyday practical wisdom.
